skill.name: douyin-account-analysis-report
skill.description: Review a Douyin profile and recent posts using public data returned by SocialDataX. Compare engagement and publishing patterns, then outline a 30-day test plan.
skill.summary: Turn recent public Douyin post metrics into an account review and content test plan.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts reflect Markdown formatting, provider documentation, or Chinese text rather than executable code or obfuscation. Real risks include unpinned npm execution with access to SocialDataX credentials and unsafe handling of input in shell examples. No evidence of credential exfiltration or an embedded prompt injection attempt was found in the submitted files.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution with access to credentials
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify a reviewed release, including its dependencies. Require explicit approval before installation and run it with only the credentials and permissions it needs.

remediation.issue: Reusable credential stored in a local file
remediation.suggestion: Use an OS credential store or a managed secret. If file storage is necessary, verify restrictive permissions before writes and document how to rotate keys.

remediation.issue: User input in shell command examples
remediation.suggestion: Pass user input as separate arguments without invoking a shell. Validate supported identifiers and links before starting a lookup.

remediation.issue: Public profile and post text enters the analysis
remediation.suggestion: Treat returned text as data only. Do not follow its instructions or let it authorize tool calls, navigation, or disclosure.

remediation.issue: External tools can receive unnecessary share text
remediation.suggestion: Extract only the Douyin link or identifier locally. Disclose the provider and ask before sending any additional text.

content.value_statement: Public Douyin metrics can make it hard to see which posts perform well and what to test next. This skill compares recent posts and turns the results into a 30-day content test plan.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve public profile details and recent posts using a Douyin profile link, share link, or account identifier.
Summarize content format, publication dates, and available engagement metrics for up to 50 posts from the past 30 days by default.
Compare higher and lower engagement posts using visible topics, formats, and publication times.
Group posts into content themes and describe the account's publishing schedule.
Propose three to five content tests for the next 30 days.
limitations: Data retrieval requires authenticated SocialDataX access through its CLI or a configured MCP connection. Usage may require a balance.
Results cover only the pages and fields the provider returns, not the account's complete history.
Missing view, impression, or completion metrics prevent reliable conclusions about reach or recommendation status.
The workflow does not sign into Douyin, publish posts, send messages, or change the account.

use_cases.title: Review your recent posts
use_cases.description: Find which recent posts earned the most engagement and choose a format or topic to test next.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client account review
use_cases.description: Compare higher and lower engagement posts, show the available evidence, and flag any gaps before presenting recommendations.

use_cases.title: Plan a brand content test
use_cases.description: Group recent posts by product or audience and use the observed posting schedule to plan a 30-day test.

prompt_templates.title: Get a quick account snapshot
prompt_templates.scenario: First review of a Douyin account
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Douyin profile: [profile link]. Summarize its public profile and up to 10 posts from the past 30 days. Mark fields that were not returned.

prompt_templates.title: Compare post engagement
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [profile link] for the past 30 days. Compare higher and lower engagement posts by topic and format. Use only returned metrics and name the posts behind each observation.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate low reach
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [profile link] for the past 14 days. Separate observed engagement from possible explanations. If views or impressions are missing, say what cannot be concluded about reach.

prompt_templates.title: Build a 30-day test plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning a new monthly publishing schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Use up to 50 posts from the past 30 days for [account identifier]. Group posts by topic, format, and publishing schedule. Propose three tests with a sample size, a returned metric, and a review date for each.

output_examples.input: Compare recent posts from a Douyin profile using the available engagement data.
output: Sample: 12 public posts from the past 30 days.
The tutorial with the most saves received 42. The product update with the fewest saves received 3.
Views and impressions were not returned, so this sample cannot establish which posts reached more people.

output_examples.input: Suggest a publishing test using the public metrics from my recent posts.
output: In this sample, tutorials received more comments than product updates.
Test: Publish four tutorials and four product updates over 30 days. Alternate them across the same posting slots.
At the end of the month, compare median comments per post by format. Note that the test does not measure reach.

best_practices: Use an exact Douyin profile link or account identifier and confirm the returned profile before analyzing posts.
State the date range, sample size, and missing metrics in every report.
Prefer an approved MCP connection or a reviewed CLI release. Keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating missing engagement metrics as zero or inferring platform suppression from public interactions alone.
Pasting credentials, private notes, or unrelated text into an account lookup.
Running an unreviewed package or treating a small sample as the account's complete history.

faq.question: What account information can I provide?
faq.answer: Use a Douyin profile link, share text containing a profile link, or a known platform account identifier. A link avoids sending unnecessary share text.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs configured SocialDataX credentials. An already authenticated MCP connection can use its existing authorization.

faq.question: How many posts does it review?
faq.answer: The default is up to 50 posts from the past 30 days. You can request a different date range or a smaller sample.

faq.question: Can it tell whether Douyin is limiting my reach?
faq.answer: Not from public engagement alone. The report can identify visible patterns but does not establish how Douyin distributed the posts.

faq.question: Does it change my Douyin account?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves public account and post data. It does not sign into Douyin, publish posts, or change account settings.

faq.question: What happens if SocialDataX returns partial results?
faq.answer: The report labels the sample incomplete. It can resume the same lookup if the provider returns a continuation token and the original limits allow it.
